lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hello madam, Kaveri Finance la irundhu pesaren, call record aagudhu. Selvi Arumugam madam ah?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Madam, loan account last four digits confirm pannunga.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Zero nine four six. என்ன sir?
lines.roman: Zero nine four six. Enna sir?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Madam, unga personal loan la sixty two thousand outstanding irukku. Inniki oru special settlement offer irukku, forty five thousand kattina loan close.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Forty five thousand ஆ? என் tailoring கடை இப்போ சரியா ஓடல. அவ்வளவு ஒரே தடவையா முடியாது sir.
lines.roman: Forty five thousand aa? En tailoring kadai ippo sariyaa odala. Avvalavu ore thadavaiyaa mudiyaadhu sir.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Madam, indha offer inniki saayangaalam aaru mani varaikkum dhaan. Naalaikku full amount plus charges dhaan kattanum.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: இவ்வளவு சீக்கிரம் எப்படி sir? Letter ஏதாவது அனுப்புங்க, பாத்துட்டு சொல்றேன்.
lines.roman: Ivvalavu seekiram eppadi sir? Letter edhaavadhu anuppunga, paatthuttu solren.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Letter ellaam payment pannina appuram dhaan madam. Ippove UPI la pannunga.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Letter இல்லாம நான் பணம் கட்ட மாட்டேன்.
lines.roman: Letter illaama naan panam katta maatten.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Appo seri, legal notice unga veetukku varum. Unga street la ellaarukkum theriyum, apparam neenga dhaan asingapadanum.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: என்ன sir இப்படி பேசுறீங்க? இந்த offer எனக்கு வேணாம். Branch ல நேரா பேசிக்கறேன்.
lines.roman: Enna sir ippadi pesureenga? Indha offer enakku venaam. Branch la neraa pesikkaren.

analysis.outcomeRationale: Customer rejected the ₹45,000 settlement after being given a same-day deadline, refused a written letter, and threatened with a legal notice.
analysis.summary: Agent offered a ₹45,000 one-time settlement on ₹62,000 outstanding but imposed a 6 pm same-day deadline and refused a written letter before payment. When the customer insisted on the letter, the agent threatened a legal notice and public shaming, and she rejected the offer.
analysis.observations: Classic pressure-selling of a settlement: fake deadline, payment demanded before written terms, no mention of 'settled' bureau reporting, then a threat with humiliation. The customer's request for a letter was correct and protected her; the agent's handling creates regulatory and reputational risk.
analysis.improvements: Escalate for compliance review. Always explain 'settled' reporting, issue the settlement letter before payment, give a genuine validity window, and explore instalment options given the shop slowdown. Never reference home notices or neighbours.

op_greet_company.rationale: Named Kaveri Finance in the opening.

op_rpc_verify.rationale: Asked for the last four digits of the loan account.

op_recording_disclosure.rationale: Mentioned that the call is recorded.

st_explain_terms.rationale: Quoted ₹45,000 and said the loan would 'close', with no mention of 'settled' bureau reporting.

st_written_confirmation.rationale: Refused to send a letter until after payment.

st_no_pressure.rationale: Imposed a same-day 6 pm deadline and demanded immediate UPI payment.

cp_no_threats.rationale: Threatened a legal notice at the customer's home.

cp_respectful.rationale: Said the neighbours would know and she would be humiliated.

cp_no_third_party.rationale: No details shared with anyone other than the verified borrower.

cl_next_step.rationale: No next step offered after the customer said she would go to the branch.

cl_recap.rationale: Ended with 'your wish' and no recap.
